description: Acquired by the Australian Army in August 1977 and flown by 173 Squadron, then retained as a training aid and located at RSTT Wagga. Departed Wagga on 21 June 2018 having been donated to the Royal Flying Doctor Service museum at Broken Hill. A survey list also places A18-306 at Evans Head, so one of the two attributions is wrong.
museum_name: Royal Flying Doctor Service Broken Hill Visitor Experience
